title: Where tasks meet sources (#71): visibility stops delivery, not the task

steps.given: a task is running and its Plugin's page is visible

steps.then: activity_changed is delivered as a #71 source, coalesced to the latest at most every 500 ms and on every state or stage change, checked against the page and the requesting Action as #71 defines

steps.when: the panel is hidden or closed
steps.then: the source stops; the task does not
the source delivers the current state once, never a backlog
